title: Diversity
text:
Introduction
LoggingDiversity is a sub-project of the BioForest project aimed at studying the Interactions between tree biodiversity, forest dynamics and climate in managed tropical forests with a pan-tropical approach. Specifically, LoggingDiversity focus on the effects of logging disturbance on tropical forest diversity - a global assessment with the following question: What is the effect of logging intensity on biodiversity, and how does it change through time?

title: Data
Model
text:
Maths
Describe.
\[\begin{align}
log(richness) \sim \mathcal N (log(\mu), \sigma)\\
\mu = \theta_{plot} \times (\phi_{plot} + LTP \times (1 - \phi_{plot}) + STP) \\
LTP = 1 - e^{-\lambda_{plot} \times time} \\
STP = \delta_{plot} \times (\frac{time}{\tau_{site}} \times e^{1-\frac{time}{\tau_{site}}})^2 \\
\delta_{plot} \sim \mathcal N ( \delta_0+\gamma_{site}\times disturbance, \sigma_{\delta})
\end{align}\]


Code
ltp <- function(time, dist, thetainf, lambda) {
  theta0 <- thetainf * dist
  ltp <- 1 - exp(-lambda * time)
  theta0 + (thetainf - theta0) * (ltp)
}
stp <- function(time, dist, thetainf, lambda, tau, delta) {
  theta0 <- thetainf * dist
  ltp <- 1 - exp(-lambda * time)
  stp <- delta * (time / tau * exp(1 - time / tau))^2
  theta0 + ltp * (thetainf - theta0) + stp * thetainf
}
data.frame(time = seq(0.1, 30, length.out = 100)) |>
  mutate(y_stp_max = stp(time,
    dist = 0.5, thetainf = 20, lambda = 0.05,
    tau = 5, delta = 0.5
  )) |>
  mutate(y_stp_min = stp(time,
    dist = 0.5, thetainf = 20, lambda = 0.05,
    tau = 5, delta = 0.25
  )) |>
  mutate(y_ltp = ltp(time, dist = 0.5, thetainf = 20, lambda = 0.05)) |>
  bind_rows(data.frame(
    time = 0,
    y_stp_max = 20, y_stp_min = 20,
    y_ltp = 20,
    y_ba_max = 30, y_ba_min = 30
  )) |>

title: Model
text:
Fits
Describe.


Code
library(cmdstanr)
out <- file.path("chains", "raw")
if (file.exists(out)) {
  unlink(out, recursive = TRUE)
}
dir.create(out)
model <- cmdstan_model("models/model.stan")
data <- read_tsv("data/derived_data/data.tsv")
ind <- data |>
  select(site, sitenum, plot, plotnum, dist_obs) %>%
  unique()
data_u <- ind |>
  left_join(filter(data, rel_year <= 0))
data_r <- ind |>
  left_join(filter(data, rel_year > 0))
mdata <- list(
  n = nrow(data_r),
  s = max(data_r$sitenum),
  p = max(data_r$plotnum),
  y = data_r$diversity_q0_sp,
  t = data_r$rel_year,
  site = data_r$sitenum,
  plot = data_r$plotnum,
  site_plot = ind$sitenum,
  n_u = nrow(data_u),
  y_u = data_u$diversity_q0_sp,
  plot_u = data_u$plotnum,
  dist_p = ind$dist_obs
)
fit <- model$sample(
  mdata,
  chains = 4,
  parallel_chains = 4,
  save_warmup = FALSE,
  refresh = 100,
  output_dir = out
)

library(tidyverse)
library(cmdstanr)
library(bayesplot)




Code
out <- file.path("chains", "rarefied")
data <- read_tsv("data/derived_data/data.tsv")
ind <- data |>
  select(site, sitenum, plot, plotnum, dist_obs) |>
  unique()
data_u <- ind |>
  left_join(filter(data, rel_year <= 0))
data_r <- ind |>
  left_join(filter(data, rel_year > 0))
fit <- as_cmdstan_fit(list.files(out, full.names = TRUE))
trajectories <- fit$summary("y_pred", "median") |>
  separate(variable,
    c("variable", "pred", "rel_year", "plotnum"),
    convert = TRUE
  ) |>
  select(-pred, -variable) |>
  rename(y = median) |>
  left_join(ind)
pars_p <- fit$summary(c("delta_p")) |>
  separate(variable, c("variable", "p", "plotnum"), convert = TRUE) |>
  select(-p) |>
  left_join(ind)
